input.checkpoint: History depth in this same instance on current ancestral history

output.undo: undo_last_merge undoes one successful merge, not necessarily the last API call
output.rollback: Restores partition and count to checkpoint

constraints.errors: Invalid vertex/future depth throws; obsolete or foreign same-depth tokens cannot be detected and violate preconditions
constraints.mutation: Read-only queries; merges and rollback mutate
constraints.history: Rolling back discards the future; no redo, branch access, or arbitrary deletion
constraints.threading: Concurrent reads only when no mutation occurs
constraints.copy: Deep value copy O(n+h); checkpoints do not transfer between objects

complexity.query_or_merge: O(log(n+1)); history vector append amortized O(1), individual reallocation O(h)
complexity.rollback: Theta(k) for k undone successful merges; each undo O(1)
complexity.space: 4n + 12h logical payload bytes; h <= n-1; capacities/expansion extra

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative lower bound on owned payload, not a peak-allocation upper bound; excludes container headers, allocator overhead and caller input

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in documentation; not formally verified
evidence.notes: Random nested rollback and undo versus full reference partitions; obsolete-token restrictions are documented

provenance.implementation: Written for this project; no source code copied
